segments.text: proposition 1 THe midwiues here mentioned, might both be Aegyptians and Hebrues.

proposition 2 The midwiues were not onelie by the lawe of nature forbidden the horrible act which they were inioined to doo by the lawe, but alſo by a lawe made by God vnto
Noah and his children againſt murther.

proposition 3 The lie which the midwiues made, although it be defended of manie to be an officious lie, yet bicauſe therein the confeſſion of the feare of the Lord is ſuppreſſed, it cannot be altogither excuſed.
proposition 4 Whereas it is ſaid that God builded a houſe for the midwiues, it ſhould ſéeme thus to be vnderſtood; namelie, that he gaue them a ſure, and ample poſteritie and familie.
